exact_statement: For every finite uniform-cube Boolean sign f with masses p_S and influences e_i, let F_J replace each physical coordinate i in J by a disjoint pair parity u_i v_i. Then H(F_J)=H(f), I(F_J)=I(f)+sum_J e_i and M(F_J)=M(f)-sum_J M_i(f), where M_i=e_i[log2(1/e_i)-D(mu_i||r_i)] with complete normalized row laws mu_i(T)=p_(T+i)/e_i,r_i(T)=p_T+p_(T+i). Each duplicated row u_i or v_i has zero M and zero erasure. Marginalizing only its partner occupancy loses exactly M_i(f) of influence-weighted KL. In contrast retaining only that partner gives laws mu=(0,1),r=(1-e_i,e_i), preserves the complete KL log2(1/e_i) and loses zero refund. Independent common spectator factors can be discarded with zero loss in this binary quotient. All-pair deletion loss divided by total physical influence equals M(f)/I(f) if J is all coordinates. For every even d>=2 an actual witness G(u,v,y)=g(uv,y), g(s,y)=b(y)-1_{y=0}+s 1_{y=0}, b(y)=(-1)^(sum_j y_(2j-1)y_(2j)), has Inf_u=Inf_v=delta=2^-d, I(G)=d/2+(d+2)delta, H(G)/I(G)<=3, and each partner-deletion loss lies in [delta(d-1),delta d]. The reference partner and core are genuinely correlated. Thus no fixed local influence allowance using only the queried/erased pair pays this loss, even though the opposite binary quotient retains it exactly. No universal terminal-core payment or FEI disproof is asserted.

exact_statement: For every actual uniform-cube Boolean seed g(z,y)=A(y)+zD(y), let delta=I_z(g), B_z=sum Phi(Ahat(T)^2,Dhat(T)^2), M_z=sum Dhat(T)^2 log2((Ahat(T)^2+Dhat(T)^2)/Dhat(T)^2), and C_z=B_z-M_z. Then 0<=C_z<=delta/ln(2). On the original parity-pair shadow g(zu,y), partner-deletion influence-weighted KL loss is L=M_z. For any fresh balanced Boolean encoder h, query actual u first in F=g(u h(x),y), then resolve the encoder completely, retaining y: the variance-weighted shadow bill Q=B_z, hence Q-L=C_z. If E_h is the fair expected cumulative inherited encoder erasure, averaged over partner branches, and T_K is the actual terminal surplus E[K I(g_leaf)-H(g_leaf)] at bit price K, then T_K-(B_z+delta E_h)=K I(g)-H(g)+JS_z(g)-(K+E_h)delta, while T_K-(M_z+delta E_h) adds C_z to that margin. For Maj3, E_h=1 under every complete adaptive encoder policy. For the actual AND2 sign seed with one positive atom at K=2, delta=1/2, B_z=1, M_z=C_z=1/2, JS_z=1 and T_2=1; both terminal children are K2-certified but the shadow-plus-inner bank has margin -1/2 whereas the KL-plus-inner bank has margin zero. Thus constant-free transfer of this exclusive terminal allowance from the KL bank to the shadow bank is false; a safe transfer adds delta/ln(2) bits (delta nats), once. No universal reserve payment or FEI disproof is asserted.
